name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
summary: Tan'jani offers a competition to catch Ghostmaw, a white crocolisk stalking the rivers. Bring its fang back to Rog'mar to claim the pot.

sections.title: Riverside Contest
sections.body: Tan'jani in Rog'mar has a competition for you. A white crocolisk called Ghostmaw stalks the rivers, and even the headhunters have not caught it. Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani; the winner claims the pot.

faq.answer: Ghostmaw is a white crocolisk that stalks the rivers.
Tan'jani in Rog'mar asks you to bring Ghostmaw's Fang.

faq.q: What does Tan'jani want me to bring?

faq.answer: Tan'jani says the winner of the competition to catch Ghostmaw claims the pot.
